arxiv-2001-02048.title: Flexible Architecture for Real-time Processing of Multiple Video Signals
arxiv-2001-02048.creator: Mohamed Awad, Islam T. Abougindia, Ahmed Elliethy, Hussein A. Aly
arxiv-2001-02048.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Mohamed Awad, Islam T. Abougindia, Ahmed Elliethy, Hussein A. Aly. Simultaneous processing of multiple video sources requires each pixel in a frame from a video source to be processed synchronously with the pixels at the same spatial positions in corresponding frames from the other video sources.

arxiv-2011-06955.title: Estimating the Copula of a class of Time-Changed Brownian Motions: A non-parametric Approach
arxiv-2011-06955.creator: Orimar Sauri, Toke C. Zinn
arxiv-2011-06955.description: Abstract Within a high-frequency framework, we propose a non-parametric approach to estimate a family of copulas associated to a time-changed Brownian motion. We show that our estimator is consistent and asymptotically mixed-Gaussian. Furthermore, we test its finite-sample accuracy via Monte Carlo. 1 Introduction One of the most fundamental results in probability theory is the so-called Sklar’s Theorem.

arxiv-2101-04379.title: Rigorous derivation of dark energy and inflation as geometry effects in Covariant Canonical Gauge Gravity Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2101-04379.creator: David Vasak*, Johannes Kirsch, Jürgen Struckmeier
arxiv-2101-04379.description: Abstract The cosmological implications of the Covariant Canonical Gauge Theory of Gravity (CCGG) are investigated. CCGG is a Palatini theory derived from first principles using the canonical transformation formalism in the covariant Hamiltonian formulation. The Einstein-Hilbert theory is thereby extended by a quadratic Riemann-Cartan term in the Lagrangian.

arxiv-2105-02355.title: A note on homological systems
arxiv-2105-02355.description: Abstract We give an elementary short proof of the known fact that the category 𝔉 ⁡ ( Δ ) \mathfrak{F}\left(\Delta\right) of Δ − \Delta- filtered modules, associated to a given finite homological system ( Δ ; Ω , ≤ ) , \left(\Delta;\Omega,\leq\right), is closed under direct summands.

arxiv-2106-01151.title: Towards Deeper Deep Reinforcement Learning with Spectral Normalization
arxiv-2106-01151.creator: Johan Bjorck, Carla P. Gomes, Kilian Q. Weinberger
arxiv-2106-01151.description: Abstract In computer vision and natural language processing, innovations in model architecture that increase model capacity have reliably translated into gains in performance. In stark contrast with this trend, state-of-the-art reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms often use small MLPs, and gains in performance typically originate from algorithmic innovations.

arxiv-2111-08930.title: Millimeter-VLBI observations of low-luminosity active galactic nuclei with source-frequency phase-referencing
arxiv-2111-08930.creator: Wu Jiang, Zhiqiang Shen, Ivan Martí-Vidal, Xuezheng Wang, Dongrong Jiang, Noriyuki Kawaguchi
arxiv-2111-08930.description: Abstract We report millimeter-VLBI results of low-luminosity active galactic nuclei (M 84 and M 87) up to 88 GHz with source-frequency phase-referencing observations. We detected the weak VLBI core and obtained the first image of M 84 at 88 GHz. The derived brightness temperature of M 84 core was about 7.

arxiv-2204-00694.title: Testing Feedforward Neural Networks Training Programs Journal: JACM Volume: XX XX XX CCS: Theory of computation Program verification CCS: Software and its engineering Maintaining software
arxiv-2204-00694.creator: Houssem Ben Braiek, Foutse Khomh
arxiv-2204-00694.description: Abstract . Nowadays, we are witnessing an increasing effort to improve the performance and trustworthiness of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), with the aim to enable their adoption in safety critical systems such as self-driving cars or aircraft collision-avoidance systems. Multiple testing techniques are proposed to generate test cases that can expose inconsistencies in the behavior of DNN models.

arxiv-2207-01553.title: Optimized FLUKA cross sections for cosmic-ray propagation studies
arxiv-2207-01553.creator: P. De La Torre Luque a, M. N. Mazziotta b
arxiv-2207-01553.description: Abstract The current great precision on cosmic-ray (CR) spectral data allows us to precisely test our simple models on propagation of charged particles in the Galaxy. However, our studies are severely limited by the uncertainties related to cross sections for CR interactions.

arxiv-2304-05520.title: Analyzing the Impact of Elusive Faults on Blockchain Reliability
arxiv-2304-05520.creator: Fernando Richter Vidal , Naghmeh Ivaki , Nuno Laranjeiro
arxiv-2304-05520.description: Abstract Blockchain recently became very popular due to its use in cryptocurrencies and potential application in various domains (e.g., retail, healthcare, insurance). The smart contract is a key part of blockchain systems and specifies an agreement between transaction participants. Nowadays, smart contracts are being deployed carrying residual faults, including severe vulnerabilities that lead to different types of failures at runtime.

arxiv-2407-15741.title: A robust, fiber-coupled scanning probe magnetometer using electron spins at the tip of a diamond nanobeam
arxiv-2407-15741.creator: Yufan Li, Gesa Welker, Richard Norte, Toeno van der Sar
arxiv-2407-15741.description: Abstract Fiber-coupled sensors are well suited for sensing and microscopy in hard-to-reach environments such as biological or cryogenic systems. We demonstrate fiber-based magnetic imaging based on nitrogen-vacancy (NV) sensor spins at the tip of a fiber-coupled diamond nanobeam. We incorporated angled ion implantation into the nanobeam fabrication process to realize a small ensemble of NV spins at the nanobeam tip.

arxiv-2501-11067.title: IntellAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Conversational AI Systems
arxiv-2501-11067.creator: Elad Levi, Ilan Kadar
arxiv-2501-11067.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming artificial intelligence, evolving into task-oriented systems capable of autonomous planning, execution, and refinement. One of the primary applications of LLMs is conversational AI systems, which must navigate multi-turn dialogues, integrate domain-specific APIs, and adhere to strict policy constraints.

pmc-10546169.title: Index hospital cost of adverse events following thoracic surgery: a systematic review of economic literature
pmc-10546169.creator: Daniel Jones, Srishti Kumar, Caitlin Anstee, Molly Gingrich, Alexander Simone, Zubair Ahmadzai, Kednapa Thavorn, Andrew Seely
pmc-10546169.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectivesAdverse events (AEs) following thoracic surgery place considerable strain on healthcare systems. A rigorous evaluation of the economic impact of thoracic surgical AEs remains lacking and is required to understand the value of money of formal quality improvement initiatives.

pmc-10590971.title: EFHD1 expression is correlated with tumor-infiltrating neutrophils and predicts prognosis in gastric cancer
pmc-10590971.creator: Bin Zhao, Shanshan Wang, Li Xue, Qingqing Wang, Yushan Liu, Qiang Xu, Qiu Xue
pmc-10590971.description: BackgroundGastric cancer (GC) ranks third in terms of mortality worldwide. The tumor microenvironment is critical for the progression of gastric cancer. This study investigated the association between EF-hand domain containing 1 (EFHD1) expression and its clinical significance in the tumor microenvironment (TME) of gastric cancer.

pmc-10638864.title: A late presentation of acute iatrogenic aortic dissection following percutaneous coronary intervention: A case report
pmc-10638864.creator: PGN Danushka, R Jayasinghe, M Munsinghe
pmc-10638864.description: Acute iatrogenic aortic dissection following percutaneous coronary intervention is a rare but sinister cause of post-procedure morbidity and mortality. Delayed diagnosis increases the mortality significantly. We present a case of a 52-year-old male who presented with an iatrogenic aortic dissection following percutaneous coronary intervention for an inferior ST-elevation myocardial infarction.

pmc-10720259.title: Socket Preservation and Guided Bone Regeneration: Prerequisites for Successful Implant Dentistry
pmc-10720259.creator: Yanko G Yankov
pmc-10720259.description: Implant success is measured not only by implant survival but also by the long-term aesthetic and functional results. Implant placement should be prosthetically driven, with proper three-dimensional positioning for optimal support and stability of the tissues. Several procedures could be performed to ensure this requirement.

pmc-12557136.creator: T Ylitörmänen, P Hakamäki, R Nick
pmc-12557136.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundPromoting wellbeing, health, and safety can improve clients’ quality of life, functional capacity, and perceived health, potentially reducing healthcare costs. Integrating health promotion into healthcare practices is essential for a holistic approach to wellbeing.

pmc-12880117.title: Metagenomic analysis of the camel rumen archaeome and its functional potential
pmc-12880117.creator: Mohamed Abdelmegeid, Mohamed Zeineldin, Rabiha Seboussi, Mahmoud Mohamadin, Abdulrahman S. Alharthi, Nabil Mansour, Lamiaa A. Okasha, Ahmed A. Elolimy, Eva-Maria Saliu
pmc-12880117.description: The camel rumen harbors a unique and underexplored archaeal community that plays a critical role in methanogenesis and ruminal fermentation. This study aimed to characterize the taxonomic composition and functional potential of the camel rumen archaeome using whole-genome shotgun metagenomic sequencing. Across the seven healthy racing camel rumen samples, the archaeal community was dominated by Euryarchaeota (50.1 ± 0.

pmc-13080552.title: Comparative Strategies to Overcome Diuretic Resistance in Heart Failure
pmc-13080552.creator: Ivna GCV Lima, Jairo T Nunes, Adriana C Luk, Darshan H Brahmbhatt, Lucas C Godoy, Michael McDonald, Filio Billia, Edimar A Bocchi
pmc-13080552.description: BackgroundDiuretic resistance complicates decongestion in heart failure (HF). Multiple add-on strategies are used, yet comparative efficacy and safety remain uncertain.ObjectivesThe objective of the study was to compare pharmacologic strategies for diuretic resistance in HF using a random-effects network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs).MethodsWe searched PubMed/Embase (January 2000–June 2024) for adult HF RCTs with diuretic resistance.

pmc-13338468.title: Five-Year Outcomes of Paclitaxel-Coated Balloons in Patients with Diabetes from the BIOLUX P-III Single-Arm Study
pmc-13338468.creator: James Dodd, Gabrielle Stratford, Marianne Brodmann, Matej Moscovic, John Chaw Chian Wang, Giovanni Nano, Thomas Zeller, Johnny Kent Christensen, Gunnar Tepe, Bibombe Patrice Mwipatayi, On behalf of the BIOLUX P-III Global Registry, Don Robertson
pmc-13338468.description: PurposeLong-term outcomes of paclitaxel-coated drug-coated balloons (DCBs) in patients with diabetes mellitus (DM) and infrainguinal peripheral arterial disease (PAD) are incompletely defined. In the current study, we evaluated 5-year outcomes in the diabetic cohort of BIOLUX P-III.Patients and MethodsBIOLUX P-III was a prospective, international, multicenter, post-market, single-arm study evaluating the Passeo-18 Lux DCB in routine practice.

pmc-13638759.title: Lactylation-driven stabilization of the S100A11/ANXA2 complex promotes pancreatic cancer metastasis
pmc-13638759.creator: Bo Zheng, Lijun Cai, Ying Deng, Lan Yang
pmc-13638759.description: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is characterized by a pronounced Warburg effect and high lactate levels. While lysine lactylation (Kla) is an emerging post-translational modification, its role in regulating the S100A11/ANXA2 complex-a critical driver of membrane repair and metastasis-remains unexplored. In this study, we identified that S100A11 (K3, K55) and ANXA2 (K49) are significantly lactylated in PDAC tissues.
